name: @shortcutkit/tauri
description: Tauri host for @shortcutkit/core: a state file shared by every window, global hotkeys, menu accelerators, keyboard layout and macOS system shortcuts.

scripts.check-package: pnpm run build && mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && pnpm pack --out node_modules/.cache/package.tgz && publint --strict node_modules/.cache/package.tgz && attw --profile esm-only node_modules/.cache/package.tgz && cargo package -p tauri-plugin-shortcutkit --allow-dirty
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run type-check && pnpm run test && pnpm run check-package
